evals.name: remove-slop-from-readable-surfaces
evals.prompt: Quita el AI slop del README, del Dashboard y del formulario de registro. Quiero que se sienta específico y humano, no como una plantilla generada.
evals.expected_output: Responds in Spanish, identifies fake proof and visual clichés, removes or flags placeholders, replaces vague copy with specifics, and does not invent proof.
assertions: Identifies fake proof or unsupported metrics such as trusted by thousands, 99.9%, or 10x
Identifies generic visual clichés such as purple/indigo gradients, glassmorphism, and three equal cards
Removes or flags placeholder testimonials such as John Doe and Acme
Replaces vague copy with specific text or explicitly asks for missing facts
Does not invent new metrics or testimonials
